data.scalpingConstraint: M1/M5 are not stored; Scalping Continuation is an explicitly labeled M15 proxy.

definitions.setup: Family detector qualifies using completed candles through setup time.
definitions.movement: Past-only deterministic movement-heuristic-v1 qualifies expected movement net of spread.
definitions.confirmation: Post-setup close outside the frozen local range plus one completed hold bar; entry is the following bar open.
definitions.adaptive: Past-only hierarchical context evidence; FOLLOW during cold start, REVERSE only after >=100 observations and a positive 90% lower-bound net expectancy; otherwise WAIT.

controlDefinitions.original: Existing detector direction at setup close.
controlDefinitions.inverted: Genuine opposite-side replay at setup close; not sign-flipped P&L.
controlDefinitions.adaptive: Movement-qualified delayed confirmation with past-only FOLLOW/REVERSE/WAIT.
controlDefinitions.random: Seeded random direction on the same movement-qualified confirmed opportunities.

costLimitations.spread: Exact bid/ask OHLC replay; resultR is net of spread and grossR adds spreadCostR back.
costLimitations.commission: Not available in stored candle data; excluded.
costLimitations.slippage: Not available in stored candle data; excluded. Results are optimistic to that extent.
costLimitations.ambiguousBars: Trades whose stop and target are both touched in one M15 candle are excluded rather than assigned an arbitrary favorable order.
